approved_decisions.agent_defaults: retain only the source-resolved values enumerated in each system freeze; common isolation, permission/no-resume, and task-scoped MCP exposure are explicit benchmark overrides
approved_decisions.budget_precedence: toolathlon-trajectories-runtime-budget-addendum.md hash overrides every old 5400-second end-to-end statement
approved_decisions.generation_override: strip product thinking/reasoning_effort values and explicitly send thinking={type:enabled}, reasoning_effort=max on every request
approved_decisions.m2_first_batch_scheduler: single worker; M1 two-slot reuse plus 26 new effective slots
approved_decisions.m3_remaining_batch_scheduler: single worker; 94 tasks and 188 effective slots after M2 GO
approved_decisions.model: deepseek-v4-flash aliasing DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 via official direct API
approved_decisions.provider_credentials: Astra and Hermes use different keys selected from fixed environment names; both keys call the same official endpoint and model
approved_decisions.provider_user_id: force a different deterministic user_id for every system/run
approved_decisions.reset_scope: per attempt: fresh product identity/home, fresh task container/workspace, then frozen Toolathlon task preprocess for application-state restoration; host setup replay is qualification/recovery only
approved_decisions.systems: exact clean source commits/trees in astra.freeze.json and hermes.freeze.json
approved_decisions.task_tool_exposure: each attempt exposes every MCP tool returned by its current task Gateway tools/list and no MCP tools from other tasks; Astra uses its native /chat/stream request-scoped runtime MCP binding, Hermes uses a fresh single-task Gateway; frozen product built-ins remain
approved_decisions.temperature: send and record 0; ineffective while explicit Thinking is enabled

infrastructure_timeouts.scope: independent safety guards; none is subtracted from or added to the Agent execution deadline and none converts a product terminal state into infra-invalid

prompt_freeze.adapter_wrapper: none; exact task/system fields are passed separately

runtime_qualification_reason: 3.3 product artifacts, rendered runtime configs, model/permission contracts, and an explicit user waiver of regression rerun are frozen; overall experiment execution still requires the independent section 3.1/3.2 and M1 gates

tool_name_semantics.analysis_boundary: record four-way mapping; if model-visible names/schemas are not equivalent, report native-product-stack comparison rather than controlled-wrapper causality
tool_name_semantics.astra: mcp__toolathlon__ prefix; non [alnum,_,-] replaced with underscore
tool_name_semantics.astra_surface: all observed names discovered and installed by the frozen Astra server from the per-attempt request_scoped_runtime_mcp binding
tool_name_semantics.exposure_scope: all and only current-task Gateway MCP tools per attempt
tool_name_semantics.hermes: mcp__toolathlon__ prefix; non [A-Za-z0-9,_] replaced with underscore
tool_name_semantics.hermes_surface: all observed names supplied by the fresh single-task Gateway
tool_name_semantics.provider_request_evidence: full tool-name list, count, and canonical SHA-256 per request; no request may contain another task's MCP name and at least one request must contain the complete current-task MCP set
